exchangeFormat: TN: RST + 4-char TN county (e.g. KNOX). Non-TN US: RST + state (DC→MD). Canada: RST + province. DX: RST + DXCC entity. Bands 160-10m + 6m + 2m (no 60/30/17/12m). CW/Phone/Digital (all digital = one class, CW separate). TN works everyone; non-TN works TN only.

scoringRules.scoreFormula: (Σ QSO pts × Σ mults, mults counted PER BAND) + bonuses. 3 pts/QSO regardless of mode. Each station workable once per Phone / CW / Digital per band (all voice = phone, all non-CW digital = one class). TN entrant mult/band = TN counties (95) + US states (49, NOT TN, DC→MD) + Canadian provinces (13) + DXCC entities (less USA/Canada/AK/HI; AK/HI=states). Non-TN entrant mult/band = TN counties (95). TN works everyone; non-TN scores TN contacts only. TN mobile/rover county-change = new QSO + new county; county-line = 2 logged QSOs. Bonus station K4TCG = +100 per QSO (once per band & mode, post-multiply). Claimed/running — the TCG TNQP committee re-adjudicates. NOT applied (off-log/self/category): TN-mobile/rover +500 per county with ≥10 QSOs AND its claim-1-extra-county multiplier (entrant-self); power/operator categories.
